classes.description: Implements string escaping strategies for Twig templates, including setting custom escapers, managing safe classes, and performing various string escapes (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, URL, HTML attributes).

methods.name: setEscaper
methods.description: Defines a new escaping strategy with a callable.

methods.name: setSafeClasses
methods.description: Sets safe classes and their associated strategies for auto-escaping.

methods.name: addSafeClass
methods.description: Adds a safe class with specific strategies to the safe classes list.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string using the specified strategy, handling different encoding and safety considerations.

methods.description: Converts string encoding using iconv, throws error if iconv is unavailable.
